name: @omp-dev-team/dev-team
description: Faithful port of bdfinst/agentic-dev-team's dev-team plugin (v10.20.0) to Oh-My-Pi. Agent prompts, skill bodies, the knowledge corpus and all 130 Python hooks/scripts are copied byte-for-byte; only the Claude Code -> OMP format conversion is applied.
comment: Version tracks UPSTREAM's version deliberately, so `dev-team 10.20.0` means exactly upstream v10.20.0 plus the format conversion. Only two extensions: plugin-root exports $DEV_TEAM_ROOT (OMP does not substitute ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} in markdown bodies), and hook-bridge runs upstream's 38 Python hook invocations against their own stdin-JSON / exit-code contract, since OMP has no `type: command` hooks. Regenerate the whole plugin with `node scripts/port-upstream-dev-team.mjs --from <adt-clone>/plugins/dev-team`; CI runs it with --check so a hand edit to a ported file fails the build. REQUIRES python3 (upstream's hooks/py.sh resolves python3 / py -3 / python).
